name: Nagoya University
summary: National university in Nagoya, founded 1939; its G30 programmes give ten English-taught bachelor's routes with October entry and no Japanese needed.

ib.text: Send school transcripts and predicted IB points (TOK/CAS not needed); the Diploma is due by 1 August 2027. No minimum score; STEM programmes recommend HL maths and science. English: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 80 (4.0 new).

dates.label: Round 2 closes, 12:00 noon JST (Automotive Engineering, Physics, Chemistry in Engineering)
IB Diploma due for those who have not yet graduated

programmes.name: Automotive Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanical engineering with an automotive focus, drawing on Nagoya's industry ties: electromechanical systems, micro- and nano-scale technology, aerospace and energy, with early courses on maths and physics.
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.
programmes.closesNote: Last of two rounds; Round 1 also open to this programme.

family.name: Automotive Engineering
family.differs: Mechanical Engineering course in the School of Engineering.

programmes.name: Automotive Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical, electronic and information engineering for the automotive field, built on basic engineering and core electrical subjects, then advanced automotive technology.
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.
programmes.closesNote: Last of two rounds; Round 1 also open to this programme.

family.name: Automotive Engineering
family.differs: Electrical, Electronic and Information Engineering course in the School of Engineering.
family.cardLine: Course: Electrical, Electronic and Information Eng.

programmes.name: Physics
programmes.about: Four years of physics taught entirely in English by the School of Science, from particle physics and condensed matter to astrophysics and plasma physics, in small classes of typically 5 to 15.
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.
programmes.closesNote: Last of two rounds; Round 1 also open to this programme.

programmes.name: Chemistry
programmes.about: Chemistry in the School of Science: foundational, organic and inorganic chemistry in the first three years, with research across engineering, agriculture, pharmacy and medicine.
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Chemistry HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.

family.name: Chemistry
family.differs: Offered through the School of Science; no second application round.

programmes.name: Chemistry
programmes.about: Chemistry in the School of Engineering: an interdisciplinary programme bridging materials science and the natural sciences, with chemistry, biology, physics and mathematics.
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Chemistry HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.
programmes.closesNote: Last of two rounds; Round 1 also open to this programme.

family.name: Chemistry
family.differs: Offered through the School of Engineering; has a second application round.

programmes.name: Biological Science
programmes.about: A joint programme of the School of Science and School of Agricultural Sciences preparing future researchers across fundamental and applied biology, including molecular, cellular and developmental biology.
programmes.ib: Biology HL, Maths HL and Chemistry or Physics HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.

family.name: Biological Science
family.differs: Biology route in the School of Science.

programmes.name: Biological Science
programmes.about: Applied bioscience in the School of Agricultural Sciences: applied microbiology, biotechnology, food and nutrition, applied biochemistry and plant sciences.
programmes.ib: Biology HL, Chemistry HL and Maths AA HL are recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.

family.name: Biological Science
family.differs: Applied Bioscience route in the School of Agricultural Sciences.

programmes.name: Social Science
programmes.about: Law and political science taught wholly in English, within a joint School of Law and School of Economics programme on political science, law, economics, business and information science.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.

family.name: Social Science
family.differs: Law and politics route in the School of Law.

programmes.name: Social Science
programmes.about: Economics with a grounding in macro- and microeconomics, then management theory, accounting, public policy and urban economics, within the joint Social Science programme taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.

family.name: Social Science
family.differs: Economics route in the School of Economics.

programmes.name: Japan-in-Asia Cultural Studies
programmes.about: The culture and history of Japan and its relations with other East Asian countries, stressing cultural history, cinema and visual culture, and literature, taught in English in the School of Humanities.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, essays and recommendation first, with no written exam; then an online interview or oral examination. Predicted IB points are accepted.

notes: You may apply to only one G30 programme in an academic year, and the right to enrol cannot be deferred.

Round 2 runs only for Automotive Engineering, Physics and Chemistry in the School of Engineering; the Chemistry (Science), Biological Science, Social Science and Japan-in-Asia programmes close after Round 1.
A one-off ¥282,000 registration fee is paid on admission; the application fee is ¥10,000.
